approach: Artwork-only reskin; preserve native layouts and sprite contracts
rules: Candidates are review targets, not instructions to repaint every sprite.
Keep finished DADG art; classify unfinished regions before editing.
Search GUI/SpriteParts, GUI/DadgMainUISpriteParts and registered DADG atlases before proposing new artwork.
Leave illustrations unchanged unless an existing, demonstrably unused DADG illustration fits the native scene theme; no newly commissioned or generated scene art.
Do not add full-screen prefab copies or decorative layout children.
Preserve sheet size, sprite coordinates, names, slicing and alpha silhouettes.
Preserve functional symbols, portraits, heraldry and semantic colours.
Keep loading-art priority fixes separate from the visual skin.
Compile assets through the supported editor workflow; do not hand-edit TPAC or RuntimeDataCache.
Do not deploy the pilot until native navigation and scaling have been verified.
